targetedTests: go -C <wt> test -run TestName ./internal/<pkg>/... ; npm --prefix <wt>/web-mobile test -- js/__tests__/<file>.test.jsx ; npm --prefix <wt>/web-mobile run test:render -- js/__tests__/render/<file>.render.test.jsx (never cd; the full gate only before claiming done or pushing)
evidence: make docs/screenshots SINCE=main (or make docs/media SINCE=main) for docs images; PR screenshots from a real browser through the running app's UI (make run-mobile) via the pr-screenshots skill, never injected data
prAssets: PNG piped as base64 to the pr-assets branch (gh api PUT contents/pr-assets/<pr>/<file>), embedded by raw.githubusercontent.com URL and curled back to confirm; see the pr-screenshots skill
rules: Read the .claude/rules/ file for an area before changing code there; Serena edits do not auto-load it.
Work only in the PR's own worktree under .claude/worktrees/, never the main checkout; address it with git -C / make -C, never cd.
Use Serena's symbolic tools for Go, TypeScript, SCSS and YAML sources; built-in Read/Edit only for languages Serena does not serve or non-code files.
Targeted tests while iterating; run the full make go/test once before claiming done or pushing, chained with && from the worktree path.
Keep the orchestrating session small: delegate reviews and investigations to subagents; Opus for implementers and the final review, Sonnet or Haiku for fixers.
The person using the app is a tired, distracted, clumsy operator who knows little kendo or Japanese; every mistake must be correctable, so warn about downstream consequences instead of refusing.
No fallback or backward-compatibility code; a storage change carries a load-time migration covering the last two releases.
Never write "default win" (name the decision: kiken, fusenpai, fusensho, hantei), "squad" (say team members) or "mat" (say shiaijo or court) in anything a person reads.
Competitor identity is the participant id, or (name, dojo) only where CLAUDE.md allows; never the name alone.
Docs under docs/ are public: no bead ids, no internal tooling, no em dashes; run make docs/build.
Everything found goes in this one PR.

Verify UI changes in a real browser, never via curl, and test self-run features from the public page; a UI change needs a real browser screenshot in the PR and every test-plan box checked before it is review-ready; build the PR body from the repo template.
New beads use the bc- prefix (bd create --id bc-<slug> --force). Keep the bead in_progress until the PR merges; then run /cleanup. Do not add or run the retired Copilot review loop.
Do not commit or push beads via git; sync them with bd dolt push, and push all git commits at the finish.
